title: Mucha: 'The Purpose of My Work'
content: Alphonse Mucha,Portrait of Madame Deschamps,1903, pencil & white chalk on tan paperAlphonse Mucha said: "The purpose of my work was never to destroy but always to create, to construct bridges, because we must live in the hope that humankind will draw together and that the better we understand each other the easier this will become."
